## Methods

### Install(Transform) {#install-transform}

Puts this into the open scene.

The camera is created here rather than borrowed from the rig. The module renders its
camera by hand into a render texture every captured frame, and doing that to the
headset's own camera would cost the scene a second full render of the eye view.

```csharp
public override GameObject Install(Transform parentOverride)
```
